prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1448; do not mention it.)
text:
I am writing to advise that this office now represents the injured party in connection with a recent collision in which a vehicle sideswiped our client while she was changing lanes. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving medical care. Please direct all further communication regarding this claim to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We ask that you provide a written statement of the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, along with any other coverage that may apply to this loss, including underinsured motorist coverage where available.

We also request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes the claim file, recorded statements, photographs, vehicle inspection and repair records, telematics or dashcam footage, and any data retrieved from either vehicle. Please confirm in writing that these materials are being retained and will not be altered or destroyed while this matter is pending.
